topicA: B2B Thought Leadership and Content Strategy
topicB: How AI is Reshaping B2B Buying and Marketing Operations

recap.intro: This week you explored two areas of B2B marketing: how to create impactful thought leadership and content, and the transformative role of AI in B2B buying and marketing operations.
bullets: Thought leadership, though often underutilized, is surprisingly the most effective way to attract new customers in some industries, and top executives spend significant time reading it.
AI tools like ChatGPT and Gemini have become the primary way B2B buyers gather information, even more so than company websites, fundamentally changing the buying process.
The biggest challenge in implementing advanced AI isn't the technology itself, but rather fixing hidden inefficiencies in internal workflows and processes.
AI is dramatically reshaping online search by rewarding overall brand trustworthiness over specific keywords, meaning companies need to rethink their entire content strategy.
recap.closing: This week you learned that adapting to new technologies and buyer behaviors, especially with AI, requires a deep understanding of both content effectiveness and organizational agility.
